name: Altitude Connect Visa Signature Card
effective_cost: Free, with no annual fee, and genuinely premium travel perks for a $0 card
pay_over_time_fee: A monthly fee up to 1.60% of the original principal amount, for U.S. Bank ExtendPay Plan or Loan balances

welcome_bonus.requirement: after you spend $1,000 in net purchases within the first 90 days of account opening

verdict.text: Strongest no-fee travel card: Priority Pass and Global Entry credit

earn_rates.category: Prepaid hotels & car rentals, Travel Center only
Travel: airlines, hotels, car rentals, taxis, limousines, trains, cruises

earn_note: The Travel Center 5x and general-travel 4x categories don't overlap: prepaid hotel/car bookings made in U.S. Bank's own Travel Center earn 5x instead of the 4x travel rate. Discount stores/supercenters, wholesale clubs, and grocery stores are excluded from the gas-category bonus; discount stores/supercenters and wholesale clubs are excluded from the grocery bonus.

redemption_options.method: Deposit to a U.S. Bank checking or savings account, or travel
Merchandise, gift cards, or statement credit

points.note: U.S. Bank gives points their maximum value as a deposit to an eligible U.S. Bank account or as travel. Other redemptions may be worth a different amount, and U.S. Bank matches charity redemptions 100%. There's no transfer-partner program behind these points, so the ceiling is lower than a transferable-currency card, but the earn rates and included travel perks largely make up for it on a no-fee card.

transfer_partners.highlight: No transfer partners: points redeem directly for cash, travel, merchandise, or gift cards, and value depends on the method. Up to 20,000 points a year can move to another qualifying U.S. Bank Altitude Go or Altitude Connect account.

credits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck Credit
credits.subtitle: $100 · every 4 years
credits.description: Statement credit covering the application fee (up to $100) for Global Entry or TSA PreCheck, once every 4 years, when the fee is charged to this card. Shown here amortized to an annual figure.
tips: Apply for Global Entry rather than just TSA PreCheck; it includes TSA PreCheck and still qualifies for this credit.

insurance.detail: Up to $2,000 per insured person for non-refundable common carrier fares · the entire trip cost must be on this card · covers you, a spouse or domestic partner, and dependent children

Up to $300 per ticket, one claim per trip, for delays over 12 hours from a covered hazard · part or all of the fare on this card. SmartDelay is listed separately: register your flight at altitudeconnect.smartdelay.com
Up to $1,000 for accidental death or dismemberment while riding a common carrier, when the entire fare is charged to this card
Not responsible for unauthorized transactions once reported

protection_note: The Guide to Benefits (effective March 1, 2026) covers trip cancellation/interruption up to $2,000 per person, trip delay up to $300 per ticket, and travel accident insurance up to $1,000. Coverage applies only when you use this card to pay for the trip. There's no purchase protection, extended warranty or rental car coverage. SmartDelay requires you to register your flight; it isn't automatic.
rental_note: No auto rental coverage: the card's Guide to Benefits (effective March 1, 2026) doesn't include any.

status_perks.name: Priority Pass Select
status_perks.note: Complimentary 12-month Priority Pass membership with four free visits a year (enroll separately at prioritypass.com/usbankaltitudeconnect), for airport lounges worldwide. Guests count against the four free visits, and after that each visit by you or a guest is charged to the card. Free enrollment is limited to one cardholder per account, including authorized users.

services.name: GigSky global data
services.detail: A complimentary 5 GB, 15-day GigSky data plan usable in 175+ countries. There's no annual limit on plans, but a new one can't start until the last one's 15 days are up. The card has to be the default payment method in the GigSky app; register at gigsky.com/visa-usb-ac. Redeemable through Nov 30, 2026, after which GigSky says the benefit ends; a plan redeemed by then can be used within 12 months.

services.name: U.S. Bank ExtendPay Plan
services.detail: Pay off up to 50% of your credit line in fixed installments with a $0 fee offer for plans opened in the first 60 days.

additional_cards.title: Authorized users

benefits.text: Earns points on their spend (into your account)
Free Priority Pass enrollment is limited to one cardholder per account. An authorized user can take that slot, but not in addition to the primary

additional_cards.note: Free to add, but only one person on the account (primary or authorized user) gets the complimentary Priority Pass enrollment.

timeline.text: Last day to redeem the complimentary GigSky global data plan. GigSky says the Altitude Connect benefit ends December 1, and plans redeemed before then can be used within 12 months.
